backing.collateral_ratio_basis: Accountable-reported total_reserves over yzUSD supply ONLY. ⚠️ The denominator excludes the yzPP and yzPRIME books, which have their own liabilities and their own ratio (collateralization_rwa). Reproduced from the published fields each run; if it stops dividing, the basis changed.
backing.surplus_deficit_basis: total_reserves - yzUSD supply, the same basis as the ratio

alternatives.note: ⚠️ Three readings of one reserve, and the spread is the point. The rated ratio divides by yzUSD supply alone and counts yzPP as cushion. ex_junior_tranche_pct removes it — yzPP is first-loss capital, but it is third-party money redeemable on a 30-day window, so the cushion can leave. over_all_yuzu_supply_pct divides by every product's supply against the same reserve. None is wrong; they differ in which liabilities the reserve is asked to cover.

peg.note: Market price from coingecko against the $1 peg target. ⚠️ 24h volume is $126.93 — a deviation struck on this little turnover is weak evidence about fair value and strong evidence about exit cost. Both readings belong.

depth_50bps.basis: The 50bps crossing is BRACKETED between $250,000 (clears) and $400,000 (2,131bps). Published figure is the last rung that cleared, so the true depth sits inside the bracket and above what is shown. Not interpolated -- rung spacing is too coarse to locate it and the curve is not linear across the gap. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL over the fill (not marginal impact at the margin), measured against this venue's own smallest quoted rung. ⚠️ That reference EXCLUDES the smallest rung's own spread, so the figure is price impact and NOT the holder's all-in cost — which is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Both are real and they answer different questions. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal and under impact vs all-in, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.

liquidity.two_pct_depth_basis: Bisected on 0x085bad2c… by direct get_dy: the sell size at which slippage crosses 200bps against the venue spot rate. ⚠️ ONE DIRECTION (selling yzUSD into USDT0) and ONE VENUE — not summed across pools, because summing assumes an arbitrageur rebalances between them mid-trade, which is a claim about the market rather than a measurement of it. liquidity.total_2pct_depth_note: Solved by bisection on the curve-dex (Plasma) pool via direct get_dy — the sell size at which slippage crosses 200bps. ⚠️ ONE DIRECTION and ONE VENUE; see total_2pct_depth_basis. ⚠️ THE LADDER BESIDE THIS IS ROUTED, NOT SINGLE-VENUE: KyberSwap covers Plasma (the config note claiming otherwise was wrong), so the rungs are a router's depth while the figure above is the pool's. Kept as TWO instruments rather than letting one replace the other, and they corroborate: both print -2.7bps at $100k, and the bisection's $310,663 sits inside the routed crossing's bracket. 24h volume is $126.93, so turnover is thin while DEPTH is not — different facts, and this asset separates them.
liquidity.pools_note: Swap venues only. ⚠️ Lending markets are listed under asset_specific.lending_exposure: they are the larger numbers and they are a liquidation-risk fact, not a peg fact — a venue that cannot quote the asset cannot price it.

exit_mark.slippage_bps_basis: PRICE IMPACT against this venue's own smallest quoted rung, which EXCLUDES that rung's own spread — it is not the holder's all-in cost. The all-in figure is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Impact is measured this way deliberately, so peg discount and source lag do not leak into it.

liquidity.by_chain_note: Swap, lending and issuer-vault TVL per chain, all from the same DefiLlama enumeration so the three are comparable. ⚠️ A chain with vault TVL and NO swap venue has no local exit — the aggregate cannot say that. ⚠️ And this is DefiLlama's view of the chain set: riskAnalyst read syzUSD satellites on Pharos and Berachain that DefiLlama does not list, so the chain count here is a FLOOR, not a census. Vault TVL is also not the same quantity as mirrored supply read on-chain; the two are close but must not be mixed.

primary_exit.buffer_identity_note: The address labelled Instant Redemption Buffer is the yzUSD token contract, not proof of cash reserves. Own yzUSD holdings are circular inventory.
primary_exit.lp_lookthrough_note: Curve and matured Pendle receipts can contain own yzUSD. Full receipt NAV is not external stablecoin liquidity; do not add receipt and underlying values together.
primary_exit.gated_note: Redemption reachability is not probed in v1. ⚠️ Unmeasured, not open.

upstream.name: [Yuzu]_yzPP (junior tranche)
upstream.note: ⚠️ CIRCULAR: yzPP is first-loss capital whose own value is a claim on the strategy book it cushions, so it stops being a cushion precisely when the book takes losses. It is not a strategy position and so is absent from exposure_split, but the rated ratio depends on it — see backing.alternatives.ex_junior_tranche_pct.

dependencies.is_partition_basis: The 22 leg shares sum to 119.38%. These dependency rows are not a certified partition: junior capital is a separate layer. A subtotal below reserves indicates incomplete coverage against that denominator; an excess does not identify a cause. Any reconciliation mechanism is NOT established. Do not normalize or infer overlap from incompleteness.

dependencies.by_protocol_note: 22 rows grouped into 10 named protocols. Concentration uses current grouped values against the published backing denominator. Unnamed allocation buckets are not inferred counterparties. Junior capital remains separately labelled.

surplus_denominators.note: ⚠️ `x_surplus` divides by the RATED surplus, which is ~90% yzPP — junior third-party capital redeemable on a 30-day window. `x_surplus_ex_junior` divides by the senior's own cushion. Both are published because the gap between them IS the finding, and a single multiple would have to pick one silently. No threshold is set on either — see exceeds_ex_junior_cushion below for how many protocols would trip one today. ⚠️ THERE IS NO CUSHION AT ALL RIGHT NOW: removing the junior tranche leaves the senior UNDER-COVERED by $1,934,265. `x_surplus` divides by a surplus that is junior money; the senior's own coverage is NEGATIVE, so no exposure has a meaningful multiple against it and the field is null rather than large.

LEVERAGE: $40,587,158 (83.8% of backing) sits in looped positions — a collateral ratio on a levered book is not that ratio on spot

NO LOCAL EXIT: at least $6,035,812 of vault TVL sits on 2 chain(s) with no swap venue — Ethereum, Sei. ⚠️ A LOWER BOUND: this enumerates DefiLlama's chain list, which omits satellites read directly on-chain (Pharos, Berachain), so the true stranded total is higher. The aggregate liquidity figure is not available to these holders

EX-JUNIOR BELOW PAR: removing yzPP's $7,641,042 of first-loss capital leaves 95.47% against yzUSD supply — the headline surplus is that tranche's money

corroboration.note: Feed figures reproduce the chain. This pairing is the only thing between this dashboard and republishing an issuer's self-reported number unchecked.

asset_specific.reserve_lookthrough_note: Issuer reserves and strategy amounts are disclosures, not verified external cash. Own yzUSD inventory is circular. Curve and matured Pendle receipts can contain own yzUSD; receipt NAV and its underlyings must not be counted twice. Cross-book Prime and unclassified receipts remain unresolved.
asset_specific.exposure_completeness_basis: Parser coverage of declared amounts only; not reserve, custody or cash-exit verification.
asset_specific.exposure_note: Disclosed strategy values and issuer total_reserves have separate source clocks. Their residual is unexplained: timing, classification or incomplete disclosure have not been distinguished. No missing-funds inference is supported. The legacy drift-named field is a signed arithmetic difference, not a causal attribution. Incomplete parsing yields a known subtotal only; unknown rows are not zero. Never derive total_backing from it. The independent reserves_split is by chain.

unknowns: quorum_denominator: m_threshold is 4 OF AN UNSTATED TOTAL — the feed carries no signer count, so 4-of-5 and 4-of-25 are indistinguishable from this payload
default_action 'block': the payload does not say what is blocked, nor whether it applies on failure to reach quorum or to unrecognised calls
verifiability '100': a string with no declared scale, and no statement of whether it is measured or asserted
governance.note: ⚠️ Pass-through from the issuer's Fordefi policy, NOT measured here. Published with its unknowns named so a renderer can show '4-of-unknown' rather than inferring a denominator. TO ESTABLISH THE DENOMINATOR: the Fordefi policy's signer set, which is not in this feed — it needs the issuer's own governance disclosure or an on-chain read of the safe.

asset_specific.wallets_note: Published by the feed; balances are not queried in v1.

history_window.note: Range is over the last 30 days (1230 points), NOT the whole file — the export retains 400 days and a full-file range is roughly twice as wide, which makes a step look like noise. reserve_step_* count numerator-only moves >1% in the same window; the per-run flag clears the next hour while the level persists, so this is the durable form.
